title: 第604章 覆灭灵山欲斩伯瑝第603章 冥河后手叮嘱玄朔
slug: 洪荒开局吞噬十一祖巫
content_zh:
洪荒东域，大雷音寺。
昔日庄严肃穆、梵音袅袅的佛门灵山，此刻已是满目疮痍、断壁残垣。漫天祥和佛韵早已被一股凛冽霸道、桀骜滔天的苍茫妖气彻底碾压、覆盖。
这片天地之间，再无半分慈悲渡化之意，唯剩杀伐决绝的无上道途。
就在半个时辰前，这里刚刚经历了一场惨绝人寰的屠戮。天蓬带领黄眉杀入灵山，墨色战衣化作催命的黑云。
他大开杀戒，将佛门高层尽数屠灭：定光欢喜佛来不及祭出法宝，便被一记裹挟着滔天魔气的重拳轰碎了金身，神魂俱灭；
毗卢佛妄图结阵抵抗，却被天蓬随手挥出的漆黑魔刃拦腰斩断，漫天佛血如雨洒落；
金箍佛祭出后天灵宝企图镇压，却被天蓬生生捏碎了法宝，连同那虚伪的佛门法相一同碾作齑粉！
……………………………………………………
整个灵山，哀嚎声与佛骨碎裂声交织，彻底沦为修罗炼狱。
此刻。一道挺拔孤峭的身影，傲然立在灵山之巅的废墟之上。
天蓬一身墨色战衣染尽佛血，衣袂翻飞之间，滚滚漆黑魔焰蒸腾不息。那魔气滔天、凛冽霸道，萦绕周身每一寸筋骨道基。
然而，灭佛以来，天蓬看起来越来越狰狞可怕，内心却愈发古井无波、澄澈平静。因为他深知，这是挣脱天道桎梏、看破佛门伪善、劈开仙佛虚妄的先天妖魔大道。
洪荒万古，道无正邪，途无对错。仙有苟且伪善，魔有坦荡赤诚。天蓬弃仙入魔，绝非沉沦堕落，而是斩断虚妄仙途，走出了一条属于自身、杀伐由心、自在由己的无上大道。
他周身妖韵厚重纯粹、道基稳固无瑕，每一缕妖气都契合天地法理、顺应自身道心，是真正勘破大道本质、逆流证道的无上真途。
天蓬立身残峰，眸光冷冽如万古寒星，俯瞰远方西天大日寺的方向，周身杀伐气机节节攀升，战意沸腾不止。
方才他亲手镇杀大雷音寺一众弟子，彻底击碎其一脉佛门气运，重创东土佛道根基。但这远远不够。
佛门根植洪荒万古，支脉繁多、气运盘根错节，多宝一死，依旧有顶尖大能坐镇佛土，延续佛门道统、争夺洪荒机运。
而眼下佛门残存最核心、最隐秘、最具气运分量的强者，便是大日如来伯瑝。
伯瑝身份极为特殊，底蕴错综复杂。他是上古妖帝帝俊长子，亦是太一亲侄，身负纯正金乌皇族血脉；
同时又是太清道人亲传二弟子，奉师命下界开宗立脉，创立大日寺佛门分支，暗中争夺洪荒气运、布局量劫。

其修为臻至混元金仙巅峰，手中执掌极品后天灵宝扶桑神剑，借大日佛火炼化剑道，佛剑合一，战力强横，稳居佛门圣人之下顶层行列。
欲彻底斩断佛门气焰、打碎东土佛运，必先破大日寺，镇伯瑝！对于伯瑝的背景，天蓬心知肚明，但他心中却只有一往无前的勇气。
天蓬眸光沉冷，杀意凛然，淡漠开口：
“黄眉。”
魔音滚滚，响彻残山。
“大雷音寺已灭，佛门气运折损五成。下一步，随本座西进，踏平大日寺，斩伯瑝，断佛门最后鼎盛道运！”
黄眉垂首合十，语气恭谨僵硬：
“属下遵星君法旨。”
二人正欲动身西进，奔赴大日佛土之际——
嗡——！
九天之上，星河倒卷，天河道韵垂落人间。一股浩瀚沉稳、雍容磅礴、至尊无上的大帝威压，自九天垂落，覆盖整片灵山残疆。
虚空云海自行分开，一道青华流光缓缓踏空降临。
望见虚空降临的青华大帝身影，一身滔天妖气的天蓬，周身凛冽杀伐气机并未收敛。
但是，他压下心中西进征战的执念，身躯微微颔首，姿态恭敬端正，全然没有面对仙佛强敌时的桀骜霸道。
“晚辈天蓬，见过青华大帝。”
声线沉稳，礼数周全，尽显玉京星君的端严底色，亦存对上古妖尊传道赐恩的赤诚敬重。
玄朔踏立虚空，星辰眸光静静落在天蓬身上，目光通透，看穿其周身浩瀚纯粹的妖魔大道，眼底无半分鄙夷、无半分厌弃。
他深知洪荒至理——大道无对错，途境无正邪。世人愚昧，以仙为正、以魔为邪，不过是狭隘偏见、虚妄定义。

content_en:
Great Leiyin Temple in the ancient Eastern Region.
The Buddhist Spirit Mountain, which used to be solemn and solemn with the sound of Sanskrit music, is now full of devastation and broken walls. The whole sky of Xiang and Buddha has long been completely crushed and covered by a cold, domineering, and unruly vast demonic energy.
In this piece of heaven and earth, there is no longer any intention of mercy and salvation, only the supreme path of killing and decisiveness remains.
Just half an hour ago, this place had just experienced a brutal massacre. Tianpeng led Huangmei into Lingshan, and his black battle clothes turned into a black cloud that urged his life.
He went on a killing spree and slaughtered all the high-ranking Buddhist sects: before Dingguang Huanxi Buddha had time to sacrifice his magic weapon, he was smashed into pieces by a heavy fist filled with overwhelming demonic energy, and his soul was destroyed;
Vairocana Buddha tried to form a formation to resist, but was cut in half by the dark magic blade swung by Canopy, and the Buddha's blood rained down all over the sky;
The Golden Hoop Buddha sacrificed the acquired spiritual treasure in an attempt to suppress it, but the magic treasure was crushed to pieces by Tianpeng Shengsheng, and the false Buddhist dharma was crushed into powder together!
……………………………………………………
The entire Lingshan Mountain was intertwined with the sound of wailing and the shattering of Buddha's bones, and it was completely reduced to Shura purgatory.
now. A tall and lonely figure stood proudly on the ruins at the top of Lingshan Mountain.
Tianpeng's black battle clothes were stained with Buddha's blood, and as his clothes fluttered, billowing black demonic flames steamed endlessly. The demonic energy was overwhelming, cold and domineering, lingering around every inch of the body's muscles and bones.
However, since the destruction of the Buddha, Tianpeng looks more and more ferocious and terrifying, but his heart becomes more and more calm, clear and calm. Because he knew very well that this was the way to break free from the shackles of heaven, see through the hypocrisy of Buddhism, and break through the illusions of immortals and Buddhas.
Throughout the ages, there has been no good or evil path, no right or wrong path. Immortals are stubborn and hypocritical, while demons are open and sincere. Tianpeng abandons the immortal and becomes a demon, which is definitely not a fall, but cuts off the false immortal path and walks out a supreme road that belongs to oneself, kills from the heart, and is free from oneself.
The allure around him is thick and pure, and the Tao foundation is solid and flawless. Every ray of evil spirit conforms to the laws of heaven and earth and conforms to his own Taoist heart. It is the supreme true path to truly explore the essence of the Tao and go against the current to realize the Tao.
Standing on the broken peak of the canopy, his eyes were as cold as the eternal cold stars, overlooking the direction of the Dari Temple in the distance, the killing energy around him was rising steadily, and the fighting spirit was boiling.
Just now, he personally killed all the disciples of Daleiyin Temple, completely shattering their Buddhist destiny and severely damaging the foundation of Eastern Buddhism. But this is far from enough.
Buddhism is rooted in ancient times, with many branches and intertwined fortunes. Even after the death of Duobao, there are still top powers sitting in the Buddhist land, continuing the Buddhist tradition and competing for the ancient fortunes.
At present, the most core, most secretive and most powerful person in Buddhism is the Great Sun Tathagata Boyui.
Boyuan's identity is extremely special and his background is complicated. He is the eldest son of the ancient demon emperor Dijun, and is Taiyi’s nephew. He is of pure Golden Crow royal bloodline;
At the same time, he was the second disciple of Taoist Taoist Taiqing. He was ordered by his master to establish a sect in the lower realms and establish a branch of Buddhism in Dairi Temple. He secretly competed for the destiny of the ancient times and planned calamities.
His cultivation has reached the peak of the Hunyuan Golden Immortal. He holds the ultimate Houtian Lingbao Fusang Divine Sword in his hand, and uses the fire of the Great Sun Buddha to refine his swordsmanship. The Buddha's sword is integrated into one, and his combat power is tyrannical. He is firmly ranked at the top level below the Buddhist saints.
If you want to completely cut off the arrogance of Buddhism and shatter the fate of Buddhism in the East, you must first destroy the Dairi Temple and suppress Boyai! Tianpeng was well aware of Boyuan's background, but he only had the courage to move forward in his heart.
Canopy's eyes were cold and murderous, and he spoke indifferently:
"Yellow eyebrow."
The demonic sound rolled and resounded throughout the remaining mountains.
"Da Leiyin Temple has been destroyed, and the fortune of Buddhism has been reduced by 50%. Next, follow me to the west, flatten Dairi Temple, kill Boyui, and cut off the fortune of Buddhism's last great prosperity!"
Huang Mei lowered his head and put his hands together, his tone was respectful and stiff:
"My subordinates abide by King Xing's decree."
The two of them were about to head west to the Great Sun Buddha Land——
Buzz—!
Above the nine heavens, the stars and rivers roll back, and the rhythm of the Tianhe River falls to the earth. A vast, steady, graceful, and supreme forceThe great emperor's pressure fell from the nine heavens, covering the entire remaining territory of Lingshan.
The sea of ​​clouds in the void separated by itself, and a stream of green light slowly descended from the sky.
Seeing the figure of Emperor Qinghua descending from the void, he was covered in a canopy of monstrous aura, and the cold and murderous aura around him had not been restrained.
However, he suppressed his obsession with marching westward, and nodded slightly, with a respectful and upright posture, not at all the unruly and domineering attitude he had when facing the powerful enemies of immortals and Buddhas.
"Junior Tianpeng, I have met Emperor Qinghua."
His voice was calm and his manners were thorough, showing the seriousness of Yujing Xingjun, and his sincere respect for the ancient demon lord's teachings and grace.
Xuan Shuo stood in the void, and the stars' eyes fell quietly on the canopy. His eyes were transparent and he could see through the vast and pure avenue of demons around him. There was no trace of contempt or disgust in his eyes.
He is well aware of the ancient truth - there is no right or wrong path, no right or wrong path. The world is ignorant and regards immortals as good and demons as evil. This is nothing but narrow prejudice and false definitions.
